messages:
sasha-cs: FYI — CobaltBank just emailed: they need completed SIG/CAIQ + our bespoke security questionnaire by EOD Fri (2026-04-02). They're also seeing intermittent 503s on /v1/generate and reported a duplicate billing charge last invoice. Escalating. @jamal-se can you replicate the 503s? @oliver-sec need short KMS/HSM answers for the CAIQ.

jamal-se: On it. I asked for customer request IDs and sample timestamps. They sent three timestamps (2026-03-28T14:12:07Z, 14:13:46Z, 14:20:02Z) plus a cURL request they used. Reproducing now against prod and dedicated env.

oliver-sec: For CAIQ: we support customer-managed keys (KMS) in Private and Dedicated via KMS/HSM integrations. Short answers we can reuse: "Key ownership: customer; envelope encryption; HSM-backed key material optional; key rotation supported via KMS integration; audit logs for key ops exposed to customer." I'll draft exact CAIQ phrasing.

nina-billing: I'll investigate the duplicate charge. Can you DM the invoice number? I can put a hold on further renewals if it's urgent.

jamal-se: Repro steps I ran:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>"
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"hello"}' -v
```
Response intermittent 503 with body: `{"error":"service_unavailable","message":"temporarily overloaded"}`. I checked request-id in headers: rg-0a1b2c3d. Queue metrics show a burst at 14:12 with slow backend ack. Dumping relevant runtime logs.

jamal-se: Suspect route-level autoscaling hit burst cap on their Dedicated pool. Also saw one auth 401 earlier from same org — token TTL mismatch (client clock skew). Will validate both.

sasha-cs: Customer also asked about audit log retention policy for Private: they want 12 months of API and key usage logs accessible in their SIEM. Can we confirm retention and export options?

oliver-sec: Retention: by default audit logs retained 90 days in the control plane. For Private we offer configurable retention up to 24 months if customer enables extended retention during onboarding; exports via S3/Cloud Storage or syslog to SIEM. I'll add exact CAIQ answers: fields 10.2.1 (logs) + 11.4.3 (KMS) draft.

kelly-pe: I'll own the CAIQ/extra bespoke form. Uploading a draft answer set to the shared drive and will ping CobaltBank with the first pass by EOD tomorrow. Need sec and billing signoff.

nina-billing: Invoice number DM'd. Found a failed retry that created a duplicate capture. I'll issue a refund and a credit note, ETA 24 hours. Will confirm in this thread when done.

deploy-bot: deploy/notice prod-inference autoscaler: scaled pool redwood-dedicated-6 -> +4 instances at 2026-03-28T14:12:30Z in response to spike.

jamal-se: After autoscale we saw error rate drop to baseline. For final root cause: correlate customer burst pattern (prefix caching miss) + token clock skew + temporary autoscale lag. I'll prepare a repro doc and suggested mitigations (client clock TTL check, request batching config, and enabling prefix caching).
